Triggers include: generate PPT from data, create data report presentation, PPT from template, data summary PPT, convert data to slides, or any request to produce a styled .pptx from existing data. The skill bundles a template generator script, a full generation script, pre-extracted template images, and detailed style/chart/table specifications.
